diagnostic_derivation.primary_source_observation: cash_conversion single-factor diagnostic at 504d in the top-500 large-cap run: t=2.3542 vs CSI300, t=4.5165 vs CSI1000; the 3-factor composite primary was falsified (t=0.91 vs CSI300)
diagnostic_derivation.secondary_source_observation: prior full-main-board run: cash_conversion 504d significant vs CSI1000 (t 2.5-3.8) but not clean vs CSI300
diagnostic_derivation.economic_rationale: earnings-quality / low-accruals anomaly (Sloan 1996): earnings backed by operating cash flow are more persistent and less manipulated, so high cash-conversion names should outperform over long holds

frozen_design.hypothesis_text: In a PIT A-share main-board top-500 large-cap universe (reusing the reviewed circ_mv materialization and the 000043 exclusion), high cash_conversion (operating cash flow backing reported earnings, an earnings-quality / low-accruals signal) produces positive cost-adjusted excess versus CSI300 over a 504-trading-day hold, surviving HAC-t, cohort, sub-period, concentration, and PIT-hygiene gates (the statistical-alpha-clue tier). Tradeability additionally requires the strategy's rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown versus CSI300 to be no worse than -15% (the tradeable-candidate tier). cash_conversion was surfaced as an in-sample diagnostic in the falsified large-cap pure-quality run; this is a diagnostic-derived new hypothesis, not a rescue, and even a positive result is an in-sample research clue pending forward-live evidence. If the single primary cell fails the statistical-alpha-clue gates, large-cap cash_conversion is falsified under this frozen design.

sub_period_robustness.rationale: 504d holds need a complete forward exit, so late entries (about 2024 onward) cannot form 504d cohorts; split by effective 504d-valid entry cohorts at their median, not by natural calendar years

risk_gate.relative_drawdown_threshold_rationale: frozen before observing cash_conversion's NAV; -0.15 is a pre-committed bound on the relative (excess) equity curve, roughly one CSI300-scale relative setback, not tuned to this factor; because the benchmark is the same-schedule CSI300 tranche portfolio, this drawdown isolates stock selection from benchmark-path mechanics

required_output_diagnostics: Report the one primary cell and its two-tier verdict: statistical-alpha-clue gates separately from the tradeable-candidate relative-NAV-drawdown gate.
Report the full-sample HAC t-stat and each sub-period half's mean excess and HAC t-stat; both halves' mean excess must be positive for the alpha-clue tier.
Report the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown and, as diagnostics only, the absolute strategy NAV max drawdown.
Report CSI300 primary and CSI1000 diagnostic without requiring both benchmarks for the alpha-clue label.
Report 504d primary and 252d diagnostic; 252d cannot rescue primary failure.
Report profitability_quality, balance_sheet_strength, and earnings_stability as diagnostics; no diagnostic factor can define alpha or rescue the primary.
Report top-500 PIT market-cap coverage, marginal industry-neutral coverage, marginal size-neutral quintile coverage for cohort-forming months, and top-count-by-month.
Report the reviewed 000043.SZ / 20191129 data-quality exclusion and confirm the signal universe drops it and backfills the next main-board name by circ_mv before scoring.
Report yearly contribution, name concentration, and tail excess.
Report restatement-exclusion application count and abort if the exclusion list is missing or unapplied.
Report no raw rows, endpoint results, request URL, or secret in any tracked summary.

statistical_alpha_clue: A future reviewed run may label large-cap cash_conversion as a research-only statistical alpha clue only if the single primary cell is positive net of costs versus CSI300, has HAC t-stat >= 2.0, at least 48 monthly cohorts, both sub-period halves with positive mean excess, and passes name / year concentration and PIT-hygiene gates.
The statistical-alpha-clue tier does not require the relative-NAV-drawdown gate; it is a statistical finding only.
tradeable_candidate_research_only: A statistical alpha clue is additionally labeled a research-only tradeable candidate only if the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown is no worse than -15%.
If the alpha-clue tier passes but the relative-NAV-drawdown gate fails, the result is a statistical alpha clue but NOT a tradeable candidate.
Even a tradeable-candidate label is research-only and cannot authorize production, ship-gate evidence, or full-size manual use.
falsified: If the primary cell fails any statistical-alpha-clue gate, large-cap cash_conversion is falsified under this frozen design.
Do not rescue a failed primary cell from CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, diagnostic factors, threshold, horizon, or benchmark changes.
diagnostics_policy: CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, single diagnostic factors, and the absolute-NAV drawdown are reporting diagnostics only.
Diagnostics may inform a later new preregistration, but only through a new reviewed ledger update and user approval.
in_sample_clue_caveat: cash_conversion was selected because it was the strongest diagnostic in the same large-cap sample, so even a passing result here is an in-sample research clue, not independent out-of-sample proof.
The vs-CSI300 evidence is single-sample (only the top-500 run); the cross-benchmark vs-CSI1000 evidence is two-sample.
Real validation requires the unchanged forward-live ship gate.

next_steps: Independent review (now Codex) must validate this preregistration, schema, ledger, tests, and docs before any signal-search work.

After review PASS and commit, a separate signal-search runner slice may be implemented that reuses the vetted measurement chain and the reviewed top-500 universe and adds the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown gate.
The signal-search runner execution still requires its own independent review, commit, and a separate user execute; it spends the new singleton ledger exactly once.
No signal-search runner execution, new data fetch, provider call, DataHub work, production claim, ship-gate claim, or full-size use is authorized by this artifact.
limitations: This artifact registers a design only; it executes no signal search and fetches no data.
cash_conversion is a diagnostic-derived in-sample clue; a positive result is research-only and the vs-CSI300 evidence is single-sample.
Statistical power is limited: 504d holds over 2018-2025 give roughly four non-overlapping windows, so the HAC t-stat rests on a short effective sample.
Industry neutralization is effectively SW-L1 (sector) level on the top-500 because SW-L2 groups rarely reach the minimum count.
The relative-NAV-drawdown threshold is a pre-committed bound, not an optimized value, and gates only the tradeable-candidate label, not the alpha-clue verdict.
A positive future backtest remains research-only until the unchanged project ship gate, including at least 12 months of forward-live evidence, is satisfied.
